map.高度越低折射越大，天顶处趋近 0。: The lower the altitude, the greater the refraction; it approaches 0 at the zenith.
map.对贴近地平线的太阳或月球做位置归算时，修正其看似被「压扁」和抬升的视位置。: When reducing the position of the Sun or Moon close to the horizon, correct the apparent position that looks flattened and raised.
map.在天文导航或测地观测中，把观测到的视高度换算回真实高度角。: In astronomical navigation or geodetic observation, convert the observed apparent altitude back to the true altitude angle.
map.为什么接近地平线折射最明显？: Why is refraction most obvious near the horizon?
map.对常规地面观测（约数度到天顶）足够好；极近地平线或要求毫角秒精度时需用更完整的折: It is good enough for ordinary ground-based observation (from a few degrees up to the zenith); very close to the horizon, or when arcsecond precision is needed, a more complete refraction table is required together with pressure, temperature and water vapour.
map.如何使用折射量（R = 1.02 / tan(h + 10.3/(h+5.11): How to use Refraction (R = 1.02 / tan(h + 10.3/(h+5.11)) arcmin)
map.大气折射量 R 表示天体因大气密度梯度而被\"抬高\"的视角偏移量；结果越大，天: The atmospheric refraction R is the apparent angular offset by which an object is raised by the atmospheric density gradient; the larger the result, the lower the true position is relative to what the eye sees.
map.按视高度角估算近地面大气蒙气差（Saemundsson 近似，单位角分）。: Estimates near-surface atmospheric refraction from the apparent altitude (Saemundsson approximation, in arcminutes).
map.在低高度角观测时，近地面大气使天体视高度被抬升，用 Saemundsson 近似: When observing at low altitude angles, the atmosphere near the ground raises the apparent altitude of the object; the Saemundsson approximation estimates the refraction to correct the telescope pointing.
map.Saemundsson 近似在什么范围适用？: Over what range does the Saemundsson approximation apply?
map.示例：视高度角 30° 时的大气折射: Example: atmospheric refraction at an apparent altitude of 30 degrees
map.视高度角需填写 0–90° 的有效数值；留空、负数或超过 90° 不计算。: Apparent altitude must be a valid number from 0 to 90°; blank, negative or above 90° is not calculated.
map.Saemundsson 公式以真高度角为参数；输入视高度后数值反求真高度及折射量: The Saemundsson formula takes true altitude; true altitude and refraction are found numerically from the apparent altitude.
map.输入视高度 30°，数值反求真高度约 29.9709°，代入真高度公式得到折射约: For an apparent altitude of 30°, numerical inversion gives a true altitude of about 29.9709° and refraction of 1.748 arcminutes; together they recover the apparent altitude.
map.视线穿过的大气路径随高度降低而变长，折射通常更大。视高度为 0° 时此近似反求约: The atmospheric path grows longer at lower altitudes, usually increasing refraction. At apparent altitude 0°, inversion gives about 34.4 arcminutes; actual near-horizon refraction varies substantially with weather.
map.单位通常为角分（′）或度（°）。视高度为 0° 时反求折射约 34.4′（0.5: The units are arcminutes or degrees. At apparent altitude 0°, inversion gives about 34.4 arcminutes (0.574°); refraction is set to zero at the zenith.
map.采用 Saemundsson 真高度近似式并数值反求；折射随气温、气压、湿度变化: The Saemundsson true-altitude approximation is numerically inverted. Refraction varies with temperature, pressure and humidity; near-horizon errors can be large. Precision measurements require meteorological observations and a more complete model.
Saemundsson approximation: R(t) = 1.02 / tan(t + 10.3/(t+5.11)) arcminutes, where t is true altitude in degrees. For apparent altitude a, solve a = t + R(t)/60 numerically. Small negative refraction at the zenith is clamped to zero. Input is limited to 0–90°; near-horizon conditions can cause large errors.
